title: SAB shared-record-header and type-field alignment research

method.kind: Primary-source web review plus local source/test inspection
method.evidenceRule: ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG AcDs container layout. Pinned ezdxf source is implementation corroboration for one SAB profile, not normative ACIS authority. Project matrices, mutable peer sources, and same-codec tests do not establish arbitrary SAB semantics or consumer acceptance.

evidence.observed: read_record() retains the leading EntityType at raw token index 0. For non-marker records, build_entities expects the common attribute pointer at raw index 1 and (for its version >=700 branch) an integer entity ID at raw index 2; type-specific data begins at raw token index 3. ODA maps R27/2013 to 21800 and says versions 20800+ are Autodesk-modified, not native Spatial ACIS.
doesNotEstablish: That this record form applies to every SAT/SAB/ASM version
DWG AcDs section framing or entity-handle association
B-rep validity or native application acceptance
evidence.planUse: For the currently projected Autodesk-modified ACIS BinaryFile 21800 profile only, validate [0]=EntityType matching the record name, [1]=Pointer, [2]=Int, preserve all raw tokens, and privately derive semantic start=3 without changing the installed DRW_SabRecord layout. Keep other profiles raw or fail closed; do not generalize the peer's >=700 branch.

evidence.topic: 21800 stream terminator and candidate profile-name boundary
evidence.observed: ODA v5.4.1 §24.2.2.3 specifies End-of-ASM-data at save version >=21800 and End-of-ACIS-data below that threshold. The pinned ezdxf R2013+ export path sets asm_end_marker=true and appends its profile-selected marker. CADMPEG v0.6.2 documents ACIS 217/218 as verified Spatial ACIS bands, but that wording plus the numeric version does not itself prove equivalence to every Autodesk-modified 21800 record profile.
doesNotEstablish: Detailed SAB entity-field grammar from ODA §24
That every ACIS BinaryFile 21800 producer emits identical records
That CADMPEG accepts this exact Autodesk-modified 21800 payload
B-rep validity, native DWG ownership association, or consumer acceptance
evidence.planUse: Generate 21800 test controls with End-of-ASM-data, retain version-1 End-of-ACIS-data controls, and admit CADMPEG only after an exact-byte parser/profile run. A parser that recognizes both markers does not imply all signature/version/terminator combinations are producer-valid.

evidence.observed: DRW_SabRecord currently stores the leading type marker and all later tokens in one vector without a semantic offset. The graph model counts every Pointer token as a node reference, and rooted pointer-row checks walk all raw tokens. Existing hand-built graph tests omit the wire-level shared prefix.
doesNotEstablish: That every produced 21800 stream violates current projection expectations
evidence.planUse: Add an in-memory, from-scratch 21800 wire-form test through the real parser. Validate the prefix, derive start=3 internally, leave the raw sequence unchanged, and apply the semantic suffix consistently to all field cursors and pointer ordinals. The source-audit risk is not a native-file failure reproduction.

evidence.observed: cq-acis publishes a manifest with source revision/blob/hash and separate source licenses; its test corpus is not in the wheel. Its shape output, like InventorLoader through FreeCAD Part, uses OCCT. ACadRust is a distinct structural parser lineage but its declared support and same-codec tests do not independently qualify geometry semantics.
doesNotEstablish: DWG AcDs parsing or owner-to-payload mapping
Support in LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, or stock FreeCAD DXF import
Permission to redistribute all peer corpus files without per-file license review
evidence.planUse: Treat any source corpus as an optional composed-stage probe with exact input/source hashes and license provenance. Do not vendor it or commit it as a regression fixture; do not add peer packages to the fast path.

limitations: No peer repository was cloned, built, installed, or run.
No generated SAB, DWG, or DXF file was created or committed in this research-only pass.
The common-header behavior is pinned-source implementation evidence, not format authority.
The local pointer-ordinal mismatch is a source-audit risk pending a parser-fed generated regression.
No B-rep semantics, independent-kernel result, native FreeCAD qualification, or external support claim was acquired.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty; no files were staged or committed.
